name: Freenove FNK0104B
description: 2.8-inch ESP32-S3 touchscreen with ILI9341 and FT6336U.
instructions: Use receivers/esp32/examples/freenove_fnk0104b from the Castboard source. The board port uses LVGL 8.4, landscape rotation 1, 16 MB flash and OPI PSRAM. Back up the existing firmware before installing.
